messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — quick question: I can't see Redwood Console (staging) in my account dropdown. I'm trying to toggle feature flag `ff-enable-simcache` for a QA run. Who grants admin access to the Console staging/admin panel? Do I file a ticket or can someone add me to a group? cc @claudia

Jamal Reed: Welcome, Maya! For staging console access we add ppl to the `console:staging:admins` group. That group also gives feature-flag UI access. If you just need to flip flags for a short test, product can do it too. :+1:

Claudia (People Ops): @Maya Chen I started an access request on your behalf. Please complete this form: https://redwood.internal/ops/access-request and set "Resource" = `console:staging` and "Role" = `admin`. I'll route to eng-platform. ETA ~1 business day :calendar:

Alex Morales: I can add you sooner if you need it today — need your GitHub username and manager (or the ticket ID). If you prefer self-serve, fill the form above.

Maya Chen: thanks! GH: maya-chen, manager: Priya Rao. I submitted the form just now. If it's faster to add you can do that Alex :pray:

Alex Morales: done — added `maya-chen` to `console:staging:admins` for 24h temp access. You should see the dropdown now. If you need longer, keep the form filled or reply here with the ticket id and approval.

Sophia Patel: Heads up — if you're toggling `ff-enable-simcache` please post a short dev note in #product-ops and add the test plan. For staging we don't require approvals, but tag @oncall if you think it might affect infra.

Deploy Bot: [flag-change] ff-enable-simcache toggled -> ON by Alex Morales from console.staging (session-id=abc123) at 2024-11-15T14:06:12Z

Maya Chen: I can see staging now, flag toggle successful. Running the QA script against the sim cache flow. Thank you all! :tada:

Jamal Reed: Welcome aboard, Maya — ping me if you hit any SLO bells during tests or see increased latency.
